 Pluto TV Adds 4 New Channels to Start November 2026
 By
 Luke Bouma 
 on
 November 3, 2026 
 in 
 All News , News 
 Pluto TV has expanded its always-on free programming with four new live channels this week, giving viewers additional continuous options as November 2026 begins. The Paramount-owned ad-supported service, which already maintains hundreds of linear channels plus a large on-demand library, added the feeds without requiring any subscription, credit card, or paid tier. The new channels appear in the live guide across the Pluto TV app, website, connected televisions, and supported streaming devices.
 The additions focus on established daytime and genre programming. Nosey Confess delivers nonstop confessional talk content centered on personal revelations involving family, friends, and relationships. Programming draws from shows hosted by familiar daytime figures, with episodes built around guests confronting secrets, seeking resolutions, and airing relationship conflicts in a studio setting. Episodes run in continuous rotation, emphasizing direct exchanges and audience-style reactions typical of long-running confessional formats.
 Judge Nosey concentrates on courtroom proceedings and legal disputes. The channel features intense hearings drawn from series such as Divorce Court, with judges handling cases involving marital breakups, property disagreements, and interpersonal conflicts. Viewers encounter a steady sequence of arguments, testimony, and rulings presented in a traditional television courtroom style, available around the clock for those seeking legal-themed entertainment.
 Universal Action supplies high-energy series and film blocks designed for constant movement and tension. The channel packages action-oriented titles that include vehicle chases, confrontations, and investigative storylines from recognizable libraries. Programming cycles through shows known for fast pacing and physical sequences, creating an uninterrupted stream aimed at audiences who prefer adrenaline-focused content over dialogue-heavy drama.
 Pluto Feel Good Drama rounds out the group with uplifting dramatic series and movies. The channel assembles stories that emphasize personal growth, relationships resolved through perseverance, and positive outcomes amid challenges. Titles rotate through character-driven plots that avoid dark endings, offering continuous viewing for viewers looking for emotionally warm or hopeful narratives within the broader drama category.
 These four channels join a broader set of November additions that have already included true-crime investigations, adventure documentaries, holiday movie pop-ups, and other genre feeds. Pluto TV has maintained a pattern of frequent linear channel launches throughout 2026, using the free model to surface library titles and thematic collections that might otherwise require searching across on-demand menus. Exact channel numbers and launch timing can vary slightly by region or device, but the feeds are positioned as permanent parts of the free lineup rather than short-term promotions.
 Viewers can locate the new channels by opening the Pluto TV live guide and scanning recent additions or searching by name. The service continues to operate entirely on advertising support, with no premium tier required to access the expanded schedule. The November expansions further increase the volume of always-available programming across reality, action, and drama categories for cord-cutters and casual streamers seeking continuous free content.
